# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Rachel Lynde  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is described as a stout, fat woman who walks with a waddle. She eventually moves to Green Gables in her older years after her husband's passing.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v3 c1 P7](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0007), [v3 c26 P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a capable, notable housewife who manages her own affairs and keeps a sharp, all-seeing eye on her neighbors' business. Outspoken and blunt, she prided herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor, which sometimes led to sharp clashes or hurt feelings. Despite a pessimistic streak and a penchant for unsolicited advice and gossip, she possesses a warm, kind heart and is always among the first to offer practical help in times of trouble or need.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for many years at Lynde's Hollow on the Avonlea main road with her quiet husband, Thomas. Notable for her notable housewifery and community leadership, she prominent managed local church societies and kept a sharp eye on all happenings in Avonlea. When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert decided to adopt a child, she expressed strong disapproval of their decision. Upon first meeting the young orphan Anne Shirley, Mrs. Rachel insulted her red hair and freckles, provoking a fiery outburst from the girl. After Anne offered a dramatic and thorough apology, Mrs. Rachel readily forgave her, becoming one of her strong supporters and admirers over the years. Active in local politics as a staunch Conservative, Mrs. Rachel attended political rallies and remained deeply involved in all village affairs. After her husband Thomas passed away following a long illness, his farm was mortgaged and eventually sold. Facing the loss of her home, she accepted Marilla Cuthbert's invitation to move into Green Gables, taking up residence in the north gable.
